The *Viññāṇanānatthapañha* ("The Question on Consciousness, Wisdom, and the Soul") is a dialogue located in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 3.7.15) [SuttaCentral]. It has been translated into English by John Kelly, with four translations recorded in three languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
In terms of parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral lists a direct parallel in the Chinese *Milindapañha* collection, T 1670b 2.74 ("Consciousness, wisdom and life principle") [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 90 matching passages across 13 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial internal reuse occurs with Abhidhamma texts such as the *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1) and *Cittaṭṭhitikathā* (Kv 2.7), other sections of the *Milindapañha* including the *Vedagūpañha* (Mil 3.3.6) and *Viññāṇalakkhaṇapañha* (Mil 3.3.12), and Nikāya discourses such as the *Sunakkhatta Sutta* (MN 105), *Pāyāsi Sutta* (DN 23), *Saṅgīti Sutta* (DN 33), and *Uddesavibhaṅga Sutta* (MN 138), alongside parallels in the Aṅguttara Nikāya (AN 3, AN 4), the Paṭisambhidāmagga (Ps 1.5), and the Niddesa (Mnd 16, Cnd 8) [DharmaNexus].
